buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Sachin Kumar . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date

4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Work site location:- The consignee of the firm of the office should have an office located in West Bengal, most preferably in Kolkata and the office must be registered under the Govt. of West Bengal. FOLLOWING DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED FAILING WHICH THE OFFER WILL BE SUMMARLY REJECTED. a. Trade License / Shop & Establishment Certificate. b. GST Registration Certificate showing the above address. 2. Tenderer (bidder) must submit a valid contractor labour licence issued by the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central) that authorises employment of at least 30 contract workers. “FAILING WHICH THE OFFER WILL BE SUMMARLY REJECTED.” 3. Similar nature of work :- A similar nature means “Tenderer should have carried out the work of providing the services of House Kee ping Assistant/ Rest House Attendant for central / state organization or PSU.” 4. Eligibility Criteria:- Work Experience:- The bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least in the last three previous finan cial years or the current financial year up to date of opening of the tender, one similar single service contr act for a minimum of 35% of advertised value of the bid.(Mandatory) 5. Financial Eligibility- The Bidders will be qualified only if they have minimum financial capabilities as belo w (A) Financial Turnover: The bidder should have an aggregate financial turnover not less than 1.5 times the advertised bid value during the last three financial years and in the current financial year up to the date of opening of the tender. The audited balance sheet reflecting financial turnover certified by chartered accou ntant with her stamp, signature and membership number shall be considered.(Mandatory) Supporting documents to be uploaded:- ● Audited balance sheet ● Average Contractual Turnover Certificate as per Annexure-V 6. Duration of contract The contract shall ordinarily remain valid for a period of two (2) years under a Rate Contract arrangement. 7. Minimum Eligibility of the candidate a. Age limit: Minimum 18 years subject to maximum 50 years. b. The person should be physically fit and able to assigned work 8. Working hours & payment provision a. 06 Days a week. Weekly Compensatory rest day to be decided by the designated Railway official.

b. The normal working hours shall be 08 (eight) hours per day for Housekeeping Staff, Cook, Helper, Carpe nter and Electrician. c. The working hours for the Caretaker shall be 12 (twelve) hours per day, as per the duty requirement of t he office/rest house. d. In case the Housekeeping Staff is not available for the full prescribed working period, payment shall be made on an hourly pro-rata basis, corresponding to the actual hours of service rendered, subject to verific ation and certification by the designated Railway official. 9. Leave Policy:- The manpower will be entitled to 15 days casual leave per year on a pro-rata basis. Beyond specified leave s as applicable, leave will be treated as leave without pay (LWP) for which necessary deduction will be ma de by the Buyer in the amount billed by the Service Provider, if no replacement of manpower is provided. 10. Service Charges:- Minimum service charge = 6% Any bidder quoting a Service Charge below 6% will be treated as non-responsive and the bid shall be rejec ted. . 7.
